INSERT INTO exclusive_content (title, slug, type, category, description, content, coverImage, bookId, featured, displayOrder, publishDate) VALUES ('Big Sister: A Bonus Epilogue from Lily''s POV', 'big-sister-bonus-epilogue', 'bonus_chapter', 'Manhattan Money Kings', 'You watched Lily go from silent to speaking. You cried when she called Camille "Mama." Now see what happens next. This scene is NOT in the book — FREE for Reader''s Club members only.

✓ Lily meeting baby Mateo for the first time
✓ The moment his tiny fingers wrap around hers
✓ Her conversation with Daddy about "showing up"
✓ The line that will wreck you (tissues required)

"Love doesn''t run out. It just gets bigger." — Lily', 'This exclusive bonus epilogue from The Billionaire''s Forbidden Nanny is told entirely from Lily''s point of view. It picks up where the story left off, giving readers a tender, emotional look at the Calloway family''s next chapter.

Lily — the little girl who didn''t speak for two years after losing her mother — is about to become a big sister. Baby Mateo is here, and everything is about to change.

This scene captures the moment Lily first holds her baby brother, the way his tiny fingers wrap around hers, and the quiet conversation she has with her daddy about what it means to "show up" for the people you love.

It''s the scene readers have been asking for — and the line at the end will absolutely wreck you.

"Love doesn''t run out. It just gets bigger."
— Lily

This bonus epilogue is exclusive to Reader''s Club members and is not available in the published book.', 'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663125551617/wyOruOlpqOcFfhnS.jpg', 30001, 1, 1, NOW());
